correctness.rationale: For a cactus the cycle rank of an occupied edge set is exactly the number of fully included host cycles, yielding independent blocks with Bernoulli parameters r_e=v_e/(q+v_e) and a single all-ones penalty delta=1-q on each cycle. A direct expansion of E(F), E(H), E(FH) under this rank-one tilt gives Cov(F,H)= -delta rho (F(1)-E0F)(H(1)-E0H)/(1-delta rho)^2 for arbitrary increasing disjoint-support functions; both factors nonnegative. Positive fields preserve r_e form, positive-probability pins either remove a penalty or retain an all-ones penalty, and product-of-NA blocks remains NA. Forest restriction is the delta=1 non-full-cycle product. For cycles length >=3, diagonal polynomial P(z)=prod(1+z_i)-delta prod z_i vanishes with all z_i in upper half-plane by choosing (1+z)/z=delta^(1/m) exp(-2pi i/m), so strong Rayleigh fails for q<1 and forest; q=1 independent Bernoulli is stable. Independently checked an exact rational triangle at q=2/5 for nontrivial increasing functions on 2 vs 1 edges: covariance=-400/48387 matches rank-one prediction. Claims include positive-weight and degenerate bridge/disconnected cases; finite check is not universal proof.
